A '''Nihilus slave''' was one of the [[Gender/Legends|men]] that operated systems control on the bridge of [[Darth Nihilus]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']]. [[Meetra Surik]], a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]; [[Visas Marr]], Nihilus's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|former apprentice]]; and [[Canderous Ordo]], the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], encountered these individuals when she confronted Nihilus during the [[Battle of Telos IV]]. They gave her a vacant stare, and had the appearance of being half-[[Death/Legends|dead]]. The seemingly undead men perished when the ''Ravager'' exploded.
